sourceOfTruth.scope: manual screen-reader and assistive-technology review evidence

releasePolicy.alpha: Schema-valid pending scenarios are permitted when component maturity remains Experimental or Alpha Stable.
releasePolicy.beta: Every scenario covering a promoted component must have complete, passing results for all required environments.
releasePolicy.stable: Complete, passing supported-browser evidence and Accessibility owner acceptance are required in component maturity evidence.

scenarios.title: Data grid navigation, selection, and state
contracts: Grid name, row and column counts, headers, cell coordinates, and sort state are understandable.
Roving focus, selection, row activation, resizing, and reordering have meaningful feedback.
Empty and loading states are announced without exposing placeholder rows as real data.
scenarios.rationale: VF-2014 defines the repeatable manual contract; a named reviewer must execute and record this scenario on Windows before beta promotion.

scenarios.title: Native text, search, number, date, and multiline input behavior
contracts: SearchInput exposes its accessible name and native search text-entry behavior without intercepting ordinary editing shortcuts.
Textarea exposes its accessible name and native multiline editing behavior, including Tab focus movement rather than application-defined roving focus.
NumberInput preserves native spinbutton navigation while its integer or decimal typing filter does not block documented navigation, editing, or modifier shortcuts.
DateInput and DateTimeInput expose their accessible names, values, constraints, and browser-native date or date-time keyboard interaction without custom focus handling.
scenarios.rationale: These five public controls require a named reviewer to execute the component-specific fixture in both required Windows/NVDA environments before keyboardDocumentation can be complete.

scenarios.title: Native selection and toggle control behavior
contracts: Select exposes its label, current option, disabled options, and browser-native keyboard selection behavior.
Checkbox exposes its label, checked and disabled state, and Space activation without introducing custom arrow navigation.
Radio and RadioGroup expose group naming, checked and disabled states, and native single-choice keyboard movement and activation.
Switch exposes switch role, accessible name, checked state, disabled state when applicable, and Space activation through its checkbox-backed native control.
scenarios.rationale: These five public controls require a named reviewer to execute the component-specific fixture in both required Windows/NVDA environments before keyboardDocumentation can be complete.

scenarios.title: Navigation and composed overlay behavior
contracts: Dropdown preserves Popover trigger expanded state, keyboard reachability of composed content, Escape dismissal, and non-stranding focus behavior.
ConfirmDialog preserves Dialog modal naming, focus containment, Escape policy, explicit confirm/cancel activation, and focus restoration.
SideNav exposes its navigation landmark and current page while ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, and End move roving focus across enabled visible items.
Breadcrumbs exposes its labelled navigation landmark and current page while links and button-backed crumbs keep their native Tab and activation behavior.
scenarios.rationale: These four public components require a named reviewer to execute the component-specific fixture in both required Windows/NVDA environments before keyboardDocumentation can be complete.

scenarios.title: Data grid auxiliary control behavior
contracts: DataGridToolbar exposes its toolbar role while contained actions remain reachable and operable using their documented component keyboard contracts.

DataGridColumnMenu exposes the Columns trigger state, labelled settings dialog, searchable columns, density choice, visibility toggles, and keyboard-reachable move/reset actions without requiring pointer drag.
DataGridSearch exposes its accessible search name and native text-entry behavior while debounced state changes do not create focus or announcement churn.
DataGridPagination exposes the Pagination region, Rows per page selection, current range/page text, and correctly disabled previous/next actions with native keyboard activation.
scenarios.rationale: These four public grid auxiliary controls require a named reviewer to execute the component-specific fixture in both required Windows/NVDA environments before keyboardDocumentation can be complete.
